meta.title: A live RFQ with a vendor's bid: "Edit Evaluation Time": "Cancel" closes it and changes nothing
warnings: moved open_prepared to the front — every later step acts on that screen
moved open_prepared to the front — every later step acts on that screen

resolved: “Directly verify the RFQ submission/bidding end time is unchanged after cancellation.” — remember + expect_remembered compare a value across elements, screens or portals (as numbers with as/delta); expect_api_value compares with the API

steps.note: Open the prepared live RFQ Responses tab with one vendor bid, as required for prepared-state cases.
Enable eRFX projects as required by the case.
Apply the required RFQ counter-offer configuration.
Apply the required bidding-time rejection configuration.
Apply the required buyer bid-editing configuration.
Apply the required percentage counter-offer configuration.
Confirm the event remains live before opening the evaluation-time dialog.
Record that the buyer sees the existing vendor response before cancellation.
Confirm the existing bid value is visible before the dialog interaction.
Open the Edit Evaluation Time window from the RFQ Settings menu.
Confirm the expected evaluation-time dialog opened.
Capture the evaluation end time shown in the dialog for comparison after cancellation.
Cancel the edit operation.
Assert that Cancel closes the evaluation-time window.
Confirm cancellation did not change the event status.
Confirm the existing vendor response and bid participation remain unchanged.
Confirm the existing bid value is still shown after cancellation.
Reopen the dialog to verify its evaluation time was not changed by Cancel.
Assert that the evaluation end time is unchanged.
Close the verification dialog without saving.
Ensure the final Cancel leaves no evaluation-time dialog open.
